components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single dominant action within a task region.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 32px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; padding: 0 12px; background: #F7931A; color: #07090A; font: 600 11px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #FFA42D; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F7931A; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(247,147,26,.18); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A quiet secondary action that does not compete with analysis.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { height: 32px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07); border-radius: 10px; padding: 0 12px; background: transparent; color: rgba(255,255,255,.72); font: 500 11px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.04); color: #fff; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F7931A; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Layer Chip
components.description: A toggle for chart overlays and time ranges.
components.css: .ds-layer-chip { border: 1px solid rgba(247,147,26,.25); border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 8px; background: rgba(247,147,26,.12); color: #FFB45A; font: 500 11px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-layer-chip:hover { background: rgba(247,147,26,.17); } .ds-layer-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F7931A; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Analytical Panel
components.description: A flat tonal container for chart, risk, ledger, or account data.
components.html:
Portfolio risk

Exposure remains within the current limit.
components.css: .ds-panel { border: 0; border-radius: 14px; padding: 20px; background: #0B0D0F; color: #fff; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 600; } .ds-panel p { margin: 8px 0 0; max-width: 70ch; color: rgba(255,255,255,.72); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: A compact search field inside the utility header.
components.css: .ds-search { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.72); font: 500 11px/1.35 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-search input { height: 36px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07); border-radius: 10px; padding: 0 12px; background: #07090A; color: #fff; font: 400 13px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: rgba(255,255,255,.45); } .ds-search input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F7931A; outline-offset: 1px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(247,147,26,.18); }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: The current destination in desktop or mobile navigation.
components.css: .ds-nav-active { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; min-height: 36px; border-radius: 10px; padding: 0 12px; background: rgba(247,147,26,.12); color: #fff; text-decoration: none; font: 500 11px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-active i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #F7931A; } .ds-nav-active:hover { background: rgba(247,147,26,.17); } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F7931A; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ledger Row
components.description: A synchronized personal event linked to a chart waypoint.
components.css: .ds-ledger-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 16px; width: 100%; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07); padding: 12px 0; background: transparent; color: #fff; text-align: left; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-ledger-row span:last-child { text-align: right; } .ds-ledger-row strong { display: block; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-ledger-row small { display: block; margin-top: 4px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.45); font-size: 11px; } .ds-ledger-row:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.025); } .ds-ledger-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F7931A; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: The interface is a precise Bitcoin ledger viewed through a modern analytical command center. Prototype A defines the reading order, prototype C supplies the interaction grammar, and prototype D defines the visual finish. The system rejects exchange urgency, generic crypto noise, neon terminal cosplay, and interchangeable SaaS cards.
keyCharacteristics: One continuous timeline across market and personal data
Tonal depth instead of decorative glass or wide shadows
Orange reserved for Bitcoin, active state, and primary action

rules.name: The Ten Percent Orange Rule
rules.body: Bitcoin Signal occupies no more than roughly ten percent of a screen. Its rarity creates hierarchy.

rules.name: The Semantic Override Rule
rules.body: Gains stay green and losses stay red. Brand orange never replaces financial meaning.

rules.name: The No Glass Rule
rules.body: Panels use opaque tonal surfaces. Decorative blur, transparent glass cards, gradient text, and wide orange glow are prohibited.

rules.name: The Stable Number Rule
rules.body: Every changing financial value uses tabular figures so updates never shift adjacent content.

rules.name: The Quiet Label Rule
rules.body: Labels use sentence case. Uppercase is limited to tickers, time ranges, and short scale markers.

rules.name: The No Terminal Costume Rule
rules.body: Monospace may identify source IDs or raw timestamps, but never becomes the default interface face.

rules.name: The Tonal First Rule
rules.body: Use Ledger Black beside Panel Black before adding any shadow.

rules.name: The Earned Shadow Rule
rules.body: Static cards never cast shadows. Only overlays and keyboard focus may leave the surface plane.

dos: Do use prototype A's reading order: market evidence, personal ledger, exposure, risk, and provenance.
Do keep prototype C's layer toggles and waypoints synchronized to one continuous timeline.
Do use the restrained black and Bitcoin Signal system from prototype D, with orange limited to Bitcoin, selection, and primary action.
Do keep desktop dense and mobile sequential while preserving labels, task order, and essential risk information.
Do label demo, delayed, estimated, incomplete, and read-only data at the point where it appears.
Do use familiar financial controls, visible keyboard focus, readable contrast, and tabular figures.
donts: Don't build generic multi-asset crypto dashboards where Bitcoin competes with token rankings, promotions, or market noise.
Don't copy exchange interfaces that prioritize order placement, leverage promotion, or urgency over analysis and risk context.
Don't use neon trading-terminal cosplay, decorative glass panels, excessive glow, or motion without a state change.
Don't use gamified profit language, confetti, streaks, fear-of-missing-out prompts, or implied financial certainty.
Don't create dense screens with no clear reading order, unexplained indicators, or metrics detached from source and time.
Don't use generic AI or SaaS dashboard patterns built around oversized hero metrics and interchangeable cards.
Don't use gradient text, colored side stripes, custom scrollbars, nested cards, or card radii above 16px.
Don't use orange for gain or loss, or rely on color alone to communicate financial state.
